reason: Why pay nearly ₹13,000 a year for software when Excel and WhatsApp are completely free and already run our practice? Even though I get anxious about article clerks leaving with client data on personal laptops, as a frugal buyer I would only ever test the free pilot first to see if the Trainee Laptop Shield actually works before spending any money.
objection: Why pay for software when Excel and WhatsApp are completely free, and will the Trainee Laptop Shield really prevent article clerks from downloading client files to personal laptops?
would_change_my_mind: Testing the free pilot and seeing firsthand that the Trainee Laptop Shield reliably blocks article clerks from downloading client data to personal laptops without disrupting our daily workflow.
